name: DeBess
purpose: De-esser that detects 's' sounds by their waveform rather than a frequency band, so it reduces sibilance while leaving the rest of the treble untouched.
avoid_for: dynamic (moving-coil) mic recordings with dull top end

params.name: Intense
params.ai_hint: Amount of de-essing. 0 is off; raise until harsh esses soften.

params.name: Sharp
params.ai_hint: Width of the ess-detection window; higher isolates esses more strictly.

params.name: Depth
params.ai_hint: How far detected esses are reduced.

hidden_params.reason: Control E (Sense) is a monitor switch: 0.5 and above outputs only the removed esses (DeBessProc.cpp). Kept at 0, normal output.

notes: Upstream description: DeBess is an improved DeEss, with perfect rejection of non-ess audio.
All Airwindows parameters are 0..1. Hints are first drafts and need refining in listening tests.
Airwindopedia notes DeBess may not engage on prosumer interfaces or moving-coil mics whose top end is dull. Add a conventional frequency-band de-esser as a fallback for those recordings.
